scope: Not a systematic novelty review; no training/data binaries/shared state touched.

conclusion.conditioning: Conditioning an existing lifetime distribution on survival to current age is standard residual-life arithmetic and does not itself use new degradation measurements.
conclusion.dynamic_overlap: Dynamic-DeepHit directly uses repeated longitudinal measurements to issue dynamically updated survival/event-time predictions; dynamic survival updating generally is not novel.
conclusion.battery_overlap: A 2025 battery RUL preprint applies Cox/CoxPH/CoxTime/DeepHit/MTLR to censored battery survival data; fixed cycle-50 Toyota representation evidence, per-cycle online update not established.
conclusion.PEAT_overlap: PEAT adapts history span using measured capacity change and updates adapter/SOH head; robust variant adds trigger, holdout early stop, rollback. It is point-RUL/SOH adaptation, not a censored conditional event-time distribution.
conclusion.boundary: Battery-specific as-of censored RUL distribution updated from new observations remains unverified; no first-use claim.

sources.citation: Lee, Yoon & van der Schaar (2020), IEEE TBME 67(1):122-133, DOI 10.1109/TBME.2019.2909027
sources.reading_scope: PubMed abstract/metadata and author code README. Full manuscript retrieval at NSF PAR failed once with 502; exact page/section and censoring likelihood unverified.
sources.evidence: Abstract says repeated longitudinal data (not only last measurement) dynamically update survival predictions for one or multiple competing risks, without fixed stochastic assumptions for longitudinal/event processes; UK Cystic Fibrosis Registry application. Author code README identifies PBC2 tutorial.
sources.mechanism: New longitudinal history is a prediction input; more than conditioning on survival to t.

sources.citation: Xue et al. (2025), Survival Analysis with Machine Learning for Predicting Li-ion Battery Remaining Useful Life, arXiv:2503.13558
sources.reading_scope: arXiv abstract and author GitHub README/results/run instructions (rendered lines 197-329); full text not read.
sources.evidence: Abstract lists Cox, CoxPH, CoxTime, DeepHit, MTLR for battery time series converted into survival data. README says Toyota uses cycle-50 representation, 362 cells, 174 uncensored/188 censored, and reports T-AUC/C-index/IBS.
sources.censoring: Censored battery observations evidenced; precise assumptions/likelihood unverified.
sources.mechanism: Battery survival modeling evidenced; per-new-cycle dynamic update not evidenced; feature granularity beyond cycle 50 unverified.
sources.boundary: Preprint; rejects broad claim no Cox/DeepHit battery application, not proof against dynamic update novelty.

sources.citation: Ren et al. (2026), Deployment-Oriented Lithium-Ion Battery RUL Prediction with Adaptive History Selection and Parameter-Efficient Updating, Energies 19(9):2135, DOI 10.3390/en19092135; preprint DOI 10.20944/preprints202603.2447.v1
sources.reading_scope: Full readable preprint HTML sections 3.1-3.5, 4.1-4.10 and conclusion. Publisher page returned 429 once; no retry.
sources.evidence: Sec 3.3 freezes CNN-LSTM backbone, updates adapter and auxiliary SOH head with RUL+SOH objective. Sec 3.4 measured capacity-change rate selects effective 10/20/30-cycle history resampled to 10 inputs. Sec 4.7 adds source-validation-calibrated mismatch trigger, holdout early stopping and rollback. Sec 4.1: 77 cells, 55 source/22 test; EOL by capacity threshold.
sources.censoring: No right-censored survival likelihood/distribution in reviewed method; point RUL-to-threshold and capacity targets.
sources.mechanism: Observed capacity drives history selection and parameter updates; direct battery observation-driven update prior art.
sources.boundary: Not an event-time distribution. Sec 3.3 uses RUL loss, but label availability at actual deployment is not established; operational causal status needs scrutiny. Cell-level harms in Secs 4.6-4.10.

conflicts: General longitudinal dynamic survival conflicts with Dynamic-DeepHit; battery Cox/DeepHit application conflicts with Xue et al.; battery observation-driven online adaptation conflicts with PEAT.
failed_access: Dynamic-DeepHit full manuscript 502 once; MDPI publisher page 429 once; no retries.
no_claim: No systematic novelty search or first-in-battery claim.
